description: Ken Lundy records this interview at UCF’s John C. Hitt Library for the Knights Tales Project on September 11, 2026. He describes having firsthand experience of 9/11 while working for Steelcase, whose New York City territory was his responsibility. After Labor Day 2001, he and his wife flew back to Grand Rapids, Michigan, and watched events unfold at Steelcase headquarters on September 11. He recalls being unable to reach his wife, who was working for Social Security, and meeting her at home later that afternoon. Lundy says his first visit to the World Trade Center towers was on Labor Day 2001, when he also met a friend in the shopping area and saw people who worked in the building. He closes by remembering the victims, expressing hope for healing, and saying that people will not forget.
